title: When the poppies bloom
text: The California poppies at the Antelope Valley poppy reserve usually bloom from mid-February through mid-May. How well they bloom depends on how much rain falls in winter and early spring. State parks does not water or stimulate the flowers, to keep the fields in a strictly natural state.

s1.title: Antelope Valley California Poppy Reserve
s1.quote: The intense blooming season for the California Poppy usually falls within late winter to early spring, during the months of mid-February through mid-May. ... Blooming seasons are dependent on the amount of rainfall during the winter to early spring seasons. ... In order to keep the fields in a strictly natural state, California State Parks does not water or stimulate the flowers.
